items.q: How old do you need to be to receive a Lady L delivery in Garfield?
items.a_html: The minimum age for adult-use cannabis in New Jersey is 21, full stop. That applies to every order Lady L processes without exception. Your age is verified when you register your account, and your driver will check your ID upon arrival and before the handoff.

items.q: What identification is needed to receive a cannabis delivery?
items.a_html: A valid government-issued photo ID is required at two points: uploaded to your Lady L account before your first order, and presented in person when your driver arrives. Driver's licenses, state-issued IDs, and passports all qualify. Out-of-state IDs are accepted.

items.q: Is a medical cannabis card required to place a delivery order in Garfield?
items.a_html: Not at all. Lady L is an adult-use cannabis microdispensary, which means any customer 21 or older can place a delivery order with a valid ID and a confirmed account. No medical card required.

items.q: What are the purchase limits for a delivery order from Lady L?
items.a_html:
New Jersey law caps each transaction at the equivalent of 28.35 grams, or one ounce, of usable cannabis. Here's how that breaks down across product types:

  • Dried Flower/Bud: 28.35 grams (1 ounce).
  • Concentrates/Resin/Oils: 4 grams (solid or liquid/vaporized oil).
  • Ingestible Items (Gummies/Edibles): 1,000 mg of THC (roughly ten 100mg packages).
  • Maximum Possession Limit: Up to 6 ounces of cannabis and cannabis products.
  • Mixing Products: You can mix and match, for example, by purchasing 1/2 ounce of flower and 2 grams of concentrates.
  • Daily Limits: The 1-ounce limit is generally considered a daily limit across all dispensaries.

items.q: What taxes will I see on a Garfield weed delivery order?
items.a_html: New Jersey adult-use cannabis carries a 6.625% state sales tax, a $2.50-per-ounce Social Equity Excise Fee (SEEF), and a 2% municipal transfer or user tax, where applicable. Every charge is itemized at checkout before you confirm, so there are no surprises on the back end.
